-        return latent

mechanism: RNNModel squeezed the length-one training time axis, so PPO's time-axis slices selected only env0 for entropy and current KL parameters. Squeeze only when masks is None, matching RNN.forward mode selection.

pull_request.title: Preserve the time axis in one-step recurrent batches
pull_request.body:
A recurrent training batch with one timestep is unpadded to `[1, num_envs, hidden_dim]`, but `RNNModel.get_latent()` then removes that time axis. PPO slices distribution parameters and entropy along the expected time axis, so this instead selects only the first environment. The unchanged policy can consequently produce a nonzero KL, an unnecessary learning-rate reduction, and entropy gradients based on one environment.

Only remove the leading axis for rollout/inference calls without masks. Batched calls retain their time dimension, including when its length is one.

The regressions compare GRU/LSTM batch outputs with sequential rollout outputs and exercise a real one-step PPO update with state-dependent standard deviations. They check the all-environment entropy objective, actor gradients and unchanged-policy learning rate. Three-step batches remain controls.

Validation on base `8945bdcbc364f388e14caebf547dbf302d89e491` with Python 3.12.3, PyTorch 2.7.1+cpu and TensorDict 0.7.2:

- Unchanged source: 4 new regressions fail, 2 controls pass.
- Corrected source: all 6 new cases pass.
- Complete CPU suite: 293 passed, 6 CUDA-only cases skipped, including successful Gloo distributed tests and JIT/ONNX export tests.
- All configured `pre-commit run --all-files` hooks and `git diff --check` pass.

In the GRU reproduction the unchanged-policy KL is 0.059998 before the fix and zero afterward; the learning rate remains 0.001 instead of dropping to 0.0006667. The LSTM reproduction shows the same failure and correction. This validates the training objective and gradients; it does not measure long-run training convergence.

Validation: https://github.com/Afloat16/rsl_rl/actions/runs/43673269357
